#Bears OL Braxton Jones (Knee) is questionable to return.

Packers OL moves: 🏈Signed G Laken Tomlinson to their active roster from the Dallas Cowboys’ practice squad. 🏈Signed G Mekhi Becton Sr. to their practice squad. 🏈Placed OL Zach Bako-Bewele on injured reserve.
Coach Todd Bowles estimated that QB Baker Mayfield will be out three weeks with his injury. https://t.co/AVQheEODlX

Sources: #Panthers star CB Jaycee Horn suffered a torn quad and is out indefinitely. One of the game's best. Horn will seek a second opinion, but he's headed for Injured Reserve and could be lost for the season. https://t.co/HINTtlOEtp
Sources: #Panthers star CB Jaycee Horn suffered a torn quad and is out indefinitely. One of the game's best.

🚨 🚨 🚨 The #Giants are trading for #Vikings former first-round QB JJ McCarthy, per me, @AdamSchefter and @MikeGarafolo. With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, NYG acquires McCarthy to help solidify their room. An intriguing add. https://t.co/DtLG1SW4Sz
From The Aftermath on @NFLNetwork: The #Bears will start Case Keenum tonight. A look at where it all stands… https://t.co/9jJzxYwLEi
Dolphins RB De’Von Achane suffered a torn ACL during Sunday’s loss to the Chiefs and will be out for the season, sources tell @rapsheet and me. https://t.co/oQrUYX1AAF

#Dolphins star RB De’Von Achane suffered a torn ACL, sources tell me and @AdamSchefter, and he’s out for the season. In an already trying season for Miami, the team loses Achane. https://t.co/xgUfQNfjet

#Panthers WR Jalen Coker, who left Sunday's game early, suffered a minor quad strain, source said. He's considered questionable for this week, but good news overall for the promising young WR. https://t.co/WrXAppeAUI

Baker Mayfield is still expected to miss some time, as he'll need to be able to grip a ball. Jalon Daniels will start going forward, but Mayfield's good news helps him back on the field sooner. https://t.co/AVQheEPbbv
First Jaxson Dart out with a major knee injury and now Brian Burns. Brutal injury situation for the #Giants. https://t.co/vtGE8edd02

#Vikings TE Josh Oliver is feared to have suffered a torn biceps in Sunday’s game and will have an MRI today determine if that is the case, sources say. Oliver would be out indefinitely if the testing confirms. https://t.co/pHZG0hj8kX

The #Bears are expected to start Case Keenum at QB against the #Eagles tonight. Caleb Williams has already been ruled out, and Tyson Bagent practiced only once this week. Bagent was eventually cleared from the concussion protocol, but Keenum is slated to start. https://t.co/CNu4WyHjQu

Reunion: The #Commanders are expected to sign FA RB Austin Ekeler to their 53-man roster pending physical, sources tell me and @MikeGarafolo. Ekeler, who is healed from an Achilles tear and worked out for the #Panthers last week, lands back in a familiar place. https://t.co/YZGlmGdFjK
For SNF, #Rams WR Puka Nacua and #Broncos WR Marvin Mims are both inactive.
#Raiders promising young WR Jack Bech, who was just ruled out of the game, suffered a broken forearm, sources say. He’s headed for IR, but should return later this season.
